# Global Commerce Council

> Documentation for the Global Commerce Council: product catalogue, trade
> knowledge base, HS code directory, country guides and trade tools, in six
> languages. Every document below is plain Markdown — request any URL with
> `Accept: text/markdown` for the source, or read it through the MCP tools
> `list_docs`, `read_doc`, `get_outline` and `search_docs`.

This repository is the documentation. It is served straight from the working
tree by serve-md (see `compose.yaml`), so what a reader sees here is exactly
what is in Git. Links are relative to the file that contains them, and YAML
front matter is metadata only: the server strips it before rendering.

## English (en_us)

- [Home](en_us): Global Commerce Council overview
- [About us](en_us/about.md): mission, what we do, values, global reach
- [Products](en_us/products): the full catalogue, by category
- [Product categories](en_us/categories): Ceramics, Gypsum, Petroleum, other industries
- [Ceramics](en_us/categories/ceramics): tiles, sanitary ware, industrial ceramics
- [Gypsum](en_us/categories/gypsum): standard, fire-resistant and moisture-resistant board
- [Petroleum & petrochemicals](en_us/categories/petroleum): crude, fuels, naphtha, bitumen, rubber
- [Other industries](en_us/categories/other): chemicals, industrial salts, sulfur, copper concentrate
- [Knowledge base](en_us/knowledge-base): trade, logistics, finance, law and marketing topics
- [Polybutadiene rubber guide](en_us/knowledge-base/polybutadiene-rubber-guide.md): applications, specifications, standards
- [HS code directory](en_us/hscode.md): how goods are classified for customs
- [Country & market guides](en_us/country-guides): regional export and import playbooks
- [Tools](en_us/tools): duty calculator, freight calculator, document templates, HS lookup
- [Supply chain network](en_us/supply-chain): raw materials through processing to end markets
- [Supplier directory](en_us/suppliers): the verified supplier network
- [Contact](en_us/contact.md): how to reach the team
- [Terms of service](en_us/terms.md)
- [Privacy policy](en_us/privacy.md)
